description: This file defines the FooTable.Cell class, which manages properties and behaviors of table cells in the FooTable plugin, including creation, collapsing, restoring, parsing, formatting, and value management.

classes.name: F.Cell
classes.description: Represents a table cell with properties and methods for managing cell content, appearance, and interactions within FooTable.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes a new FooTable.Cell instance with references to the table, row, column, and cell value or element.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Defines the cell's value, element, classes, and styles based on input.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates or updates the cell's DOM element and detail row, setting classes and styles.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the cell into a detail row for expanded view.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores the cell from a detail row back to its original position.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Calls the column's parser function to parse the cell's content.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the cell's value using the column's formatter function.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the cell's value, updating DOM and appearance accordingly.

methods.name: _setClasses
methods.description: Sets CSS classes on the cell element based on cell and column classes.

methods.name: _setStyle
methods.description: Sets inline styles on the cell element based on cell and column styles.
